component.name: Dive Astronaut
component.summary: Restore the colors of underwater videos and photos

description.p: Dive Astronaut brings back the colors that water steals from your dive videos and photos. Red and contrast return automatically, frame by frame, right on your computer: your files are never uploaded.

ul.li: Automatic underwater color correction for videos and photos from GoPro, DJI, phones and any camera
Batch queue: add many files or a whole folder, click Start and keep working
Editor with cut, speed, text, music, logo, picture-in-picture and templates
Vertical reels (9:16) for Instagram, TikTok and Shorts with automatic framing
Upscale, frame rate and bitrate options

description.p: Sign in with the same Google or Apple account you use in the Dive Astronaut app on Android, iPhone or Mac. The Linux app is included in Dive Astronaut Pro.

screenshot.caption: The app's before/after comparison of a corrected dive video
